artifact.name: Metaform
artifact.description: Community-extensible inference platform that maps artifacts into typed project knowledge, executes authored workflows, and coordinates agent work through a plugin microkernel.

element.ef: Provides an extensible runtime that turns artifact structure into addressable typed knowledge and uses that knowledge to coordinate reusable inference work.

join.op: Keep Metaform's stable chassis independent of feature implementations while allowing built-in and community features to be enabled, disabled, loaded, and removed through the same public contract.
join.observation: A plugin kernel keeps extension modules outside the stable kernel and activates them through a defined extension boundary.

join.op: Give Metaform a base project memory graph of namespace-addressed Elements and RE-owned joins that later knowledge layers, memories, and inference can extend.
join.observation: A knowledge service resolves addressable objects and the relationships and layers attached to them.

join.op: Execute intake and other authored inference operations as real workflows while preserving authored text, bindings, context references, and operative behavior.
join.observation: A workflow engine converts workflow definitions into ordered executable work while retaining definition structure.

join.op: Coordinate Metaform module operations and agent assignments across synchronous, asynchronous, direct-harness, and in-harness execution without losing work identity.
join.observation: An execution service carries work context and lifecycle across operation boundaries.

join.op: Expose the same Metaform functional operations through contextual CLI, MCP, and web surfaces while keeping the CLI complete when web and MCP are absent.
join.observation: An interface adapter maps external interaction surfaces onto a shared operation contract.

join.op: Retain project-owned Metaform state, origins, variants, assignments, knowledge, modules, settings, edit copies, and reconstruction references in the initial global store while source artifacts remain at their existing locations.
join.observation: A persistence service preserves authoritative state beyond individual process lifetimes.

join.op: Make every Metaform-produced record traceable to its producer, prompt revision, rendered prompt, bindings, referenced inputs, received answer, and dependent inference.
join.observation: A provenance service links produced records to the inputs and operations that created them.

element.ef: Provides a stable microkernel that discovers, enables, disables, loads, and unloads external feature modules through shared chassis services and a public extension contract.

join.op: Let dynamically loaded Metaform modules publish runtime changes and subscribe to them without coupling feature implementations to one another or moving workflow progression into notifications.
join.observation: An event bus dispatches published events to registered subscribers.

element.ef: Resolves namespace-addressed objects and receiver-owned joins, attaches selectable knowledge layers, and exposes memory and inference at those addresses.

join.op: Hide or reveal Metaform-derived layers from their contributing namespace objects and dependent inference while retaining the saved knowledge and its source relationships.
join.observation: Derived knowledge can be traced to the records and operations on which it depends.

element.ef: Preserves authored workflow definitions, converts supported serializations, binds context objects, and executes ordered steps through shared operations.

join.op: Lexicalize Metaform workflow steps with namespace object references, selected knowledge layers, appended imperatives, and inspectable context objects without automatically rewriting imported workflow text.
join.observation: A workflow engine can bind addressable context objects and selected knowledge to executable steps.

join.op: Issue assignments and execute intake and other authored Metaform workflows through the shared runtime rather than treating workflow names as passive run metadata.
join.observation: A workflow engine delegates executable steps to a runtime that owns operation lifecycle and completion.

element.ef: Runs synchronous and asynchronous operations with explicit assignment context, work identity, lifecycle, and harness adaptation.

join.op: Recover Metaform assignment context from nonce and workfolder bindings across independent command invocations and retain durable completion history after active local bindings are cleared.
join.observation: An execution service persists assignment state when work must continue across separate invocations.

join.op: Record Metaform operation context and produced results as assignments, module calls, agent submissions, and workflow steps execute.
join.observation: An execution service associates each operation result with the context and inputs that produced it.

element.ef: Adapts shared operation and object services to external interaction surfaces without changing the underlying execution semantics.

join.op: Make contextual CLI, MCP, and web calls invoke the same Metaform module operations and assignment lifecycle, including complete non-web CLI operation from the installed command, module entrypoint, or executable wheel.
join.observation: An interface adapter delegates work to an execution service instead of implementing feature behavior itself.

element.ef: Publishes runtime changes to dynamically registered synchronous and asynchronous subscribers with attributable module and work context.

join.op: Run Metaform module subscribers on the shared synchronous and asynchronous runtime while retaining publishing module, project, assignment, provenance, and failure attribution.
join.observation: An event bus can dispatch synchronous and asynchronous handlers through a shared runtime.

element.ef: Maintains authoritative durable state for projects, source origins, variants, assignments, settings, knowledge, module state, and reconstruction references.
Relates produced records to their producer, prompt revision, rendered prompt, bindings, inputs, received answer, and dependent inference.

join.op: Keep Metaform lineage, source ownership, prompt and answer history, dependency records, and produced-object relationships durable inside the global project-aware store.
join.observation: A provenance service persists lineage records so traceability survives the producing process.
